name: Doubt ~Usotsuki Otoko wa Dare?~
original_name: ダウト～嘘つきオトコは誰？～
source:
Lies, truths, and misunderstandings...
Which of these men can you trust?


"Have you been cheating on me?!"
A breakup with your cheating boyfriend leads you...

...straight into the arms of ten gorgeous men?! But beware! Nine of these ten guys are no-good liars!

Just you watch. I'll find Mr. Right.
These liars don't stand a chance!
translation:
谎言、真相与误会……
这些男人中，究竟谁值得信任？


“你是不是背着我出轨了？！”
与出轨的男友分手后，你竟然……

……一下子邂逅了十位俊美的男人？！但要小心！这十个人里，有九个都是不怀好意的骗子！

走着瞧吧，我一定会找到命中注定的那个人。
这些骗子休想得逞！
